correctness.rationale: For A=(Z/3)^3 and inclusive Hamming distance <=2, enumerated all 5949 nonempty faces with f-vector (27,243,945,1728,1620,945,351,81,9), 2951 acyclic Morse pairs and 47 critical cells (one vertex and 46 dimension-3 cells), and all 27189 Hasse arcs; 5949 topological-sort visits certify acyclicity. Lefschetz signed-face counts for all 27 translations produce traces 46,4,-2,1 by weights 0,1,2,3; the orbit complexes for nonzero representative weight 1/2/3 have f-vectors (9,18,6),(9,9,3),empty. Character Fourier transform using (1-t)^k(1+2t)^(3-k) yields multiplicity 2 at character weight <=2 and 1 at weight 3; total 46 and two invariant lines. In characteristic zero, quotient homology equals invariants after barycentric subdivision.
